Dismounts of a motor-rifle squad on a BMP (gunner and driver stay with the vehicle): research default chosen by the owner 2026-11-11 (he corrects it afterwards). 180 rifle rounds on the soldier and 600 machine-gun rounds in the squad follow the cited norms; hand grenade and launcher-round counts are game values. See docs/research/squads.md. The machine gunner carries part of the belts himself; the rest are carried by other men (handing them over arrives with ammunition sharing in M4). D1 (2026-11-14): every man carries one smoke hand grenade (game value, low; sources do not give the issue per man). Ranks (owner 2026-11-15): contract soldiers (conscripts are not sent into combat); a contract private stays ryadovoy or yefreytor, so most men keep those; one most typical rank per slot (DECISIONS.md 2026-11-15 realistic ranks; low). Squad leader serzhant (mladshiy serzhant or serzhant per post), machine gunner yefreytor, the others ryadovoy/yefreytor.

The first squad of a motor-rifle platoon: as motor-rifle-squad, with the platoon's rifleman-medic in place of the rifleman with the GP-25 (M10.1, owner Q-1c). Dismounts of a motor-rifle squad on a BMP (gunner and driver stay with the vehicle): research default chosen by the owner 2026-11-11 (he corrects it afterwards). 180 rifle rounds on the soldier and 600 machine-gun rounds in the squad follow the cited norms; hand grenade and launcher-round counts are game values. See docs/research/squads.md. The machine gunner carries part of the belts himself; the rest are carried by other men (handing them over arrives with ammunition sharing in M4). D1 (2026-11-14): every man carries one smoke hand grenade (game value, low). Ranks (owner 2026-11-15): contract soldiers (conscripts are not sent into combat); a contract private stays ryadovoy or yefreytor, so most men keep those; one most typical rank per slot (DECISIONS.md 2026-11-15 realistic ranks; low). The first squad's leader is the deputy platoon commander (starshiy serzhant; battleorder.org BTR company: deputy platoon commander a senior sergeant). The strelok-sanitar a yefreytor with the medical course (low).

Dismounted motor-rifle platoon (M6): the platoon commander and three squads, no separate headquarters (post-2008 structure per the cited analysis, search extract only). Owner to correct. M7.2 (owner Q2): three BMP-2 with fixed three-man crews; each squad (its leader included) rides in the back of its own BMP-2, the platoon commander in the back of the first. The crews are only used when vehicles are switched on (until M7.4a: &vehicles=1 and the tools scenarios). D1 (2026-11-14): every man carries one smoke hand grenade (game value, low; sources do not give the issue per man). M9.2: the platoon commander carries the platoon's thermal weapon sight (research default, low; Ratnik's night optics have limited distribution). M9.4a (owner M9 round): the platoon commander carries and flies the platoon's quadcopter with three batteries (no separate headquarters and no seat left in the first BMP-2 for an operator: game assumption, low, owner to review).

BMP-2 crew (M7; owner 2026-11-12: a fixed three-man crew; squad leaders ride in the back). Ranks are typical, not sourced; personal weapons come with M7.2. M7.2: each crewman carries an AK-74M with three magazines, helmet and vest (game value, low).

BMM crew (M10.6-data): commander, driver-mechanic and a medic (crew of three, search extracts). Ranks and loads are game values. Not in any platoon: ambulances come from off the map (M10.6a). Members in crew-seat order (commander, medic, driver), so a lab without placements seats them as the template names. Review fix 2026-11-15 (game values, low): every crewman wears the red cross armband (medical transport personnel, GC I art. 24 and 40), and the medic carries a medic bag with the platoon medic's kit in smaller numbers (care given on foot, e.g. after a bail-out; loading at the nest stays abstracted).

M8.3a: one 82 mm 2B14 and its crew of four (Wikipedia, search extract): commander with the radio and the smoke rounds, gunner with the tube, two loaders with twelve HE rounds each (24 HE + 6 smoke at the tube: game values, low).

M8.3a: one 120 mm 2B11 (2S12 Sani) and its crew of five (Rostec: crew 5): commander with the radio and smoke rounds, gunner with the tube, three loaders with five HE rounds each (15 HE + 4 smoke at the tube; the truck's load is not modelled: game values, low).
M8.3a: two 2B14 crews (a company mortar section; game organisation, low).
M8.3a: two 2S12 Sani crews (a battalion mortar platoon in part; game organisation, low).

M9.3b (owner: a Metis-M team at company level attached to the platoon battle): the 9P151 launch post and four 9M131 rounds with a crew of three: commander with the radio and a round, operator with the launch post and a round, loader with two rounds (the real Metis-M crew is two men carrying the post and rounds in packs; the third man and the rounds per man are game values, low). The operator keeps his AK-74M (no pistol in the data).

M7.6d: an AGS-30 team of two (Army Recognition: gunner and ammunition carrier, medium) with three boxes of 29 VOG-30: the gunner carries the gun and one box, the commander the radio and two boxes (loads are game values, low; in a battalion the AGS sit in the grenade launcher platoon, six AGS-17: battleorder, medium). Placed with the assault group (assault-group scenario) as a unit of its own.

Assault team of an assault group (M7.6d): three men (3-man fire teams: euromaidanpress, medium-low): team leader with AK-74M and GP-25, an RPG-7V gunner with two PG-7VL, a man with the RPO-A (composite, low).

Fire team of an assault group (M7.6d): PKP gunner, assistant with belts, SVD marksman (the fire-support element: euromaidanpress, thelightningpress, medium-low; composite, low). The group's AGS-30 team is a unit of its own (raschet-ags).

Reserve of an assault group (M7.6d): two riflemen with a spare RPO-A each, a PKP belt and a PG-7VL (a reserve section with riflemen and ammunition: euromaidanpress, medium-low; composite, low). The extra AGS box of the plan is not carried: only the AGS team's own men feed its gun.

Assault group (shturmovaya gruppa, M7.6d): 13 men on foot. A composite of the reported 2023 assault tactics (Pulaski report; euromaidanpress 2023-03-14; thelightningpress: assault platoons of 12-15 in 3-man teams, a command group with a UAV team, a fire-support element, a reserve; medium-low): command (commander with GP-25 and a thermal sight, radio and drone operator with the group's quadcopter), two assault teams (Shturm 1 and 2: GP-25, RPG-7V, RPO-A), a fire team (Ogon: PKP, assistant, SVD), a reserve (Rezerv: two riflemen with spare RPO-A and ammunition). The AGS-30 team (raschet-ags) goes with it as a unit of its own. Loads and ranks are game values (low). Used only by the opt-in assault-group battle.
T-72B3M crew (M7.6a): commander, gunner, driver (published: three). Ranks are typical, not sourced; each carries an AK-74M with two magazines, helmet and vest (game value).
T-90M crew (M7.6a): commander, gunner, driver (published: three). Ranks are typical, not sourced; each carries an AK-74M with two magazines, helmet and vest (game value).

M7.6b: two T-72B3M (the most numerous modern Russian tank in service: medium, from search extracts only). Two tanks attached to a motor-rifle platoon's attack is a game value (low); the T-90M is available through the scenario's tankTemplates override.
M7.6b: two T-90M, for the scenario's tankTemplates override (the manifest's section is the more numerous T-72B3M). The attachment is a game value (low).

BTR-82A crew (M7.6c): commander, gunner (operator-navodchik in the turret) and driver (crew of three: army-technology, ROE; search extracts, medium). Ranks and the personal loads as the BMP-2 crew's (game values, low).

A motor-rifle squad on a BTR (M7.6c): the BMP squad's six dismounts (motor-rifle-squad) plus the assistant machine gunner that BTR and MT-LB platoons add (battleorder.org, search extract, medium): seven, the BTR-82A's seven places. M7.6d: the second GP-25 rifleman is the squad's marksman with the SVD (battleorder says BTR squads typically have one, search extract, medium; a forum claim that the SVDs moved to a brigade marksman company is disputed); six SVD magazines are a game value (low). Loads otherwise as motor-rifle-squad's; the assistant MG gunner carries two PKP belts (game value, low).

Motor-rifle platoon on BTR-82A (M7.6c, slice 41): as motor-rifle-platoon (the platoon commander with the thermal sight and the quadcopter, no separate headquarters) in three BTR-82A. The first squad keeps six men with the platoon's rifleman-medic (binding medical answer) because the platoon commander rides in its BTR (6 + 1 = 7 places); the second and third squads have seven with the assistant machine gunner. 30 men (battleorder.org: about 30, 1 officer + 29; search extract).
